tooltip.sporebound.rift_talisman.enter: Use on a Rift Cairn. Entry costs one ender pearl.
tooltip.sporebound.rift_talisman.return: In the Blighted World: use anywhere to return freely.
message.sporebound.instructions: Activate the amethyst center of a Rift Cairn with this talisman.
message.sporebound.incomplete: Rift Cairn: amethyst center, crying obsidian edges, polished deepslate corners; clear three blocks above.
message.sporebound.sanctuary: Mushroom sanctuaries reject the rift. Build your cairn elsewhere.
message.sporebound.pearl: Carry an ender pearl to open the rift. Returning is free.
message.sporebound.arrived: The Blighted World. Use your talisman to return, or touch the cairn center with an empty hand.
message.sporebound.obstructed: No safe landing was found. Clear space around the destination cairn or world spawn.
tooltip.sporebound.rift_talisman.lore: A watching eye, listening for the world beyond.
item.sporebound.hivebound.binding: Binds when worn. Removable only in Index -1 or -2 dimensions.
item.sporebound.hivebound.symbiosis: Full set: Spore kinship and evolution. Corruption strengthens you; clean worlds weaken you.
item.sporebound.hivebound.evolution: Feeds on you. Earn evolution by kills; crouch + empty-hand interact to consume weaker infected.
message.sporebound.awakening_failed: Crouch-use a Rift Talisman at a complete cairn with an amethyst shard offhand, then confirm within 10 seconds. Requires Index -1.
message.sporebound.travel_failed: Travel requires Hyper evolution, a node within 12 blocks, a safe destination, and a ready 30-second cooldown.
